## Available benchmarks

### [Study 01: Separated-locus fine-mapping](01_finemapping/separated-development-pilot.qmd)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Complete development benchmark |
| Study type | Fine-mapping and credible-set evaluation |
| Methods | ST-BED BayesC; ST-BED BayesR; ST-CSR SBayesC; ST-CSR SBayesR |
| Architectures | Separated causal loci |
| Replicates or chains | 10 replicates |
| Primary outputs | Marker recovery, causal ranks, credible sets |
| Validation | 40/40 fits; simulation oracles and strict alignment passed |
| Capsule | [v1.1 reproducibility capsule](../results/reference/01_finemapping/separated-development-v1.1/README.md) |

### [Study 02: Single-trait prediction](02_prediction/prediction-development-pilot.qmd)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Complete five-replicate development benchmark |
| Study type | Held-out single-trait prediction |
| Methods | ST-BED BayesC; ST-BED BayesR; ST-CSR SBayesC; ST-CSR SBayesR |
| Architectures | Sparse homogeneous; sparse variance mixture |

### [Study 04: Multichain convergence](04_convergence/convergence-development-pilot.qmd)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Complete multichain development benchmark with five-replicate validation |
| Study type | Operational multichain convergence diagnostics |
| Methods | Matched ST-BED/CSR BayesC and BayesR |
| Architectures | Sparse homogeneous; sparse variance mixture |
| Recommendation-generating run | One replicate per matched architecture; 4 method fits; 16 chains |
| Fixed-setting validation | Five replicates per matched combination; 20 method fits; 80 chains |
| Primary outputs | R-hat, bulk/tail ESS, relative MCSE, burn-in stability, recommendations |
| Validation | Recommendation run: 4/4 fits and 16/16 chains; fixed-setting validation: 20/20 fits and 80/80 chains, with recommendations supported in all five replicates |
| Capsule | [Recommendation-generating capsule](../results/reference/04_convergence/st-multichain-convergence-development-v1/README.md); [five-replicate validation capsule](../results/reference/04_convergence/st-multichain-convergence-validation-five-replicate-v1/README.md) |

### [Study 06 v2: Retained low-rank LD operator validation](06_ld_operator/retained-low-rank-operator-development-v2.qmd)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Complete five-replicate development benchmark |
| Study type | Retained-low-rank LD operator validation |
| Package | `sblr` 0.2.0 at commit `bd8e2c8148a0d9540dc20716455706beeb16fa86` |
| Architectures | Sparse homogeneous; sparse variance mixture |
| Scale | 2 architectures; 5 paired replicates; 6 configurations; 60 four-chain fits |
| Configurations | Packed BED; full CSR; runtime-matched block CSR; near-full retained low rank; retained mass 0.999; retained mass 0.995 |
| Primary outputs | Deterministic operator validation; prediction; parameter recovery; marker-effect agreement; variable selection; convergence; runtime; storage; retained rank and mass; residual-drift diagnostics |
| Validation | 60/60 canonical fits; 14/14 pilot fits; 10/10 convergence fits; no reconstructed-dense fit in the primary grid; maximum residual drift approximately `2.4869e-14` |
| Readiness decision | **READY FOR MTBLR LOW-RANK EXTENSION** |
| Capsules | [Convergence capsule](../results/reference/06_ld_operator/st-low-rank-operator-convergence-development-v2/README.md); [five-replicate capsule](../results/reference/06_ld_operator/st-low-rank-operator-five-replicate-development-v2/README.md) |

### [Historical Study 06 v1: Reconstructed-dense block-eigen benchmark](06_ld_operator/ld-operator-development-pilot.qmd)

This immutable historical benchmark used the reconstructed-dense block-eigen
operator. It remains available as historical evidence and must not be confused
with the retained-low-rank Study 06 v2 benchmark.

## Planned benchmarks

- Fine-mapping with realistic LD.
- High-LD causal architecture.
- Multi-trait prediction after computational optimization.
- Scientific-scale annotation-informed models after convergence redesign.
- Multi-trait operator and prediction benchmarks.
